summary: All 15 files in this work unit contain substantive formal mathematical content — definitions, theorems, and proofs (some with `sorry`) — relevant to the formalization of p-adic modular forms following Serre's approach. None are pure import aggregators, stubs, data dumps, or placeholders. The root module `PadicModForms.lean` is the main entry point re-exporting the entire library. The `ForMathlib/` files provide staged material for upstreaming (Bernoulli numbers, p-local integers, sigma series, etc.). The `ModP/` files build the mod-p theory (filtration, Hasse invariant, theta operator, degree-zero forms, Artin-Schreier). The `PAdic/Weights/CongruencePow.lean` file states Serre's Théorème 1 with a `sorry` on the final assembly but contains the full proof infrastructure. The `pLocalInt/Discriminant.lean` file proves the structure theorem for p-integral modular forms. Per FILTER-002/004/007/021, no hard exclusion is justified.
